title: Minimax Estimation of Treatment-Specific Entropy with Learned Propensity and Vanishing Outcome Densities
banked_reason: The promised all-alpha sharp risk-and-honest-length frontier is replaced by a supercritical matched theorem plus unresolved subcritical/critical brackets, so the central rate, logarithm, and attaining rules remain undelivered on [1/20,1/4].
gap_reasons: The promised all-alpha sharp risk-and-honest-length frontier is replaced by a supercritical matched theorem plus unresolved subcritical/critical brackets, so the central rate, logarithm, and attaining rules remain undelivered on [1/20,1/4].

Below 1/4, the lower order n^(-4alpha/(4alpha+1)) and upper order n^(-2alpha)(log n)^(2alpha+1) differ polynomially, leaving the exact propensity-learning cost and any additional no-floor penalty undetermined.
At alpha=1/4, the unresolved (log n)^(3/2) gap prevents deciding critical preservation or equality of the complete preservation sets.
proof_attempt_summary: Two D0 rounds produced an informal known-propensity root-n benchmark, observable coarse upper construction, full-record lower law, and an off-critical phase-transition theorem. The unpruned cubic route fails at the rough endpoint; feasible pruned localization and matching subcritical/critical orders remain open, and D0.5 rejected substituting brackets for the promised sharp full-alpha frontier. Source retrieval was repaired and passed; independent MAIN validity audit confirms run-level non-delivery, not impossibility; no F stages, Lean proofs, promotion, or presentation occurred.
tldr: Fixed-scale treatment-specific entropy can be estimated from the original records with globally honest uncertainty even when outcome densities vanish. On the entire stipulated class, both minimax absolute risk and honest interval length have the matched order \(n^{-1/2}\) for every fixed \(\alpha>1/4\). Knowing the entire propensity also gives this order throughout the public range. For \(\alpha<1/4\), learning propensity incurs a provably polynomially diverging relative cost; explicit whole-class rate brackets quantify it. At \(\alpha=1/4\), the proved bracket runs from \(n^{-1/2}\) to \(n^{-1/2}(\log n)^{3/2}\). Exact subcritical rates, any additional no-floor penalty there, and the critical logarithmic boundary remain open.
gap: KBW supply smooth-functional counterfactual-density inference, and HJWW supply direct-draw entropy estimation. Neither verified theorem supplies the entire learned-selection entropy frontier.
fill: The focal question requires explicit original-record attaining constructions and normalized same-class converses for risk and honest length. Every logarithm, elbow and propensity-information preservation region is derived.
